title: 第15章 我怀疑你跟我夫人有私情第16章 要不先进行体力双修
slug: 救了元婴宗主夫人醒后她急了

大殿里死寂无声，连风都仿佛被冻结了。空气沉闷得像灌了铅，压在人的肺管子上，每一口呼吸都必须用力去拉扯。
刚才那一连串的变故，简直就是在阎王爷的生死簿上乱涂乱画，稍有半点差池，此刻他早就连灰都不剩了。
陆长生趴在地上，后背的小衣早已被冷汗浸得透湿，大殿里幽冷的穿堂风一吹，布料冰凉地贴在皮肉上，冻得他不受控制地打了个寒颤。
刚费尽心思填平了一个要命的大坑，转眼又被人一脚踹进了深井里。这剑无尘老登的疑心病绝对是晚期，彻头彻尾的无药可救。
单独召见？子时？
这摆明了是要避开柳师师，把他拎到一个没人看得见的角落里“坦白从宽”。
要是这老王八蛋不讲武德，一上来就直接给他来个搜魂，那他连开口忽悠的机会都没有，当场就得交代在这里。
一个练气期的小小杂役，胆敢给堂堂元婴期的大佬戴绿帽，这罪名一旦被坐实，别说投胎了，就算是被挫骨扬灰、抽出神魂日夜用丹火炙烤，在那位宗主眼里恐怕都算是轻饶。
“长生……”
柳师师颤巍巍地从地上站起身，她那双平日里修长笔直的腿此刻软得厉害，连站立都有些不稳。她下意识地伸出手，想要去抓陆长生的衣袖。
那只手冰凉刺骨，在半空中抖得像是风中的落叶，显然这位往日里高高在上的师尊，已经被剑无尘刚才的杀机吓破了胆。
“别慌，师尊。”
陆长生眼角余光瞥见她的动作，不动声色地微微侧了侧身，恰到好处地避开了她的碰触。他压低嗓音，用只有两人能听见的微弱气音警告了一句。
接着，他胡乱抹了一把脸上还在往外渗的虚汗，强行在脸上挤出了一个比哭还要难看百倍的笑容。
他深吸一口气，刻意扯起嗓子，让自己的声音在大殿的每一个角落都能听得清清楚楚，装出一副正气凛然、毫无心虚的模样：
“师尊不必担忧，宗主英明神武，单独召见弟子，左不过是问几句日常的闲话罢了。弟子身正不怕影子斜，坦坦荡荡，何惧之有？”
嘴上喊得大义凛然，仿佛要慷慨就义的忠臣，可他心里早就把剑无尘的祖宗十八代都拉出来问候了一遍。
但人在屋檐下，脖子上还架着无形的刀，他除了硬着头皮接下这催命的旨意，根本别无选择。
夜色浓稠得像是一砚化不开的残墨，抬头望去，连半点星光都寻不见，真正的伸手不见五指。

山风凄厉，如同一把把看不见的钝刀子，呼啸着刮在人的脸上。冷气顺着宽松的衣领粗暴地灌进胸膛，冻得人骨头缝里都泛着酸疼。
陆长生双手死死拽着自己那件单薄的弟子服衣襟，站在剑无尘所在的洞府前。
他的双腿在暗夜里不受控制地打着摆子——真不是因为这山风太冷，而是纯粹被死亡的阴影笼罩所带来的恐惧。
四周静得让人发慌，草虫的鸣叫声全无，耳边只剩下自己胸腔里那颗心脏砰砰狂跳的动静，沉重得连耳膜都震得隐隐作痛。
在没有一丝光亮的黑暗中，洞府石门四周若隐若现地流转着繁复的禁制纹路。那纹路哪怕只是静静蛰伏，散发出来的灵压也让人觉得头皮发麻。
这种级别的阵法，别说他区区一个练气期，就算是内门那些筑基期的长老一头撞上去，也会在顷刻间被碾成一滩肉泥。
陆长生艰难地咽了一口唾沫，喉管干涩得发疼。好不容易风干的冷汗，此刻又争先恐后地从毛孔里涌了出来，黏糊糊地贴在背脊上，随着夜风的吹拂，难受得要命。
跑吧。
他脑子里有一个疯狂的声音在呐喊。什么宗门，什么修仙，找个深山老林躲起来当个凡人，哪怕天天吃糠咽菜混吃等死，总好过把脑袋别在裤腰带上送给这老怪物当球踢。
可理智又像一盆冰水狠狠泼下——跑不掉的。元婴大能的神识一旦铺展开来，足以覆盖整座宗门。
他那点可怜的修为，只怕连山门前那道石阶都没迈出去，就会被一只无形的大手像捏臭虫一样直接捏死。没有退路，只能把命押在赌桌上。
陆长生闭上眼睛，狠狠做了一个深呼吸，把手心里湿漉漉的冷汗在衣摆上用力蹭了蹭。他咬紧后槽牙，抬起颤抖的手，敲向了那扇冰冷的石门。
咚。
咚。
咚。
三声闷响，在死寂的夜风里显得格外刺耳，每一下都像是沉甸甸的铁锤，直愣愣地砸在他的天灵盖上。
“进。”
一道冷漠、干枯，听不出一丝活人气息的声音从洞府极深处幽幽传出，宛若万年不化的寒冰。
陆长生喉结滚动了一下，双手按在沉重的石门上，用力一推。
嘎吱——

令人牙酸的摩擦声打破了夜的沉寂。紧接着，一股常年不见天日的陈旧霉味，混杂着足以割裂肌肤的凛冽剑气，如同一阵狂风般扑面而来，呛得他肺腑生疼，险些咳嗽出声。

There was deathly silence in the hall, and even the wind seemed to be frozen. The air is as dull as lead, pressing against the tubes of the lungs, making every breath require straining.
The series of changes just now were like scribbling on the book of life and death of Lord Yama. If there was even the slightest mistake, there would be no ashes left in him at this moment.
Lu Changsheng was lying on the ground, and the clothes on his back were already soaked with cold sweat. When the cold draft in the hall blew, the fabric was cold against his skin, making him shiver uncontrollably.
I had just tried my best to fill up a big fatal hole, but in the blink of an eye I was kicked into a deep well again. This Jian Wuchen Laoden's suspicion is definitely at an advanced stage and is completely incurable.
Summoned alone? Zishi?
This was clearly to avoid Liu Shishi and take him to a corner where no one could see him to "confess and be lenient."
If this old bastard didn't have martial ethics and had just given him a soul search as soon as he came up, he wouldn't even have a chance to open his mouth and lie, and he would have to confess on the spot.
A little handyman in the Qi training stage dared to cuckold a big boss in the Nascent Soul stage. Once he was convicted of this crime, let alone being reincarnated, even if he was crushed to ashes and his soul was extracted and roasted with elixir fire day and night, in the eyes of the sect leader, it would probably be considered a light mercy.
"Longevity..."
Liu Shishi stood up from the ground tremblingly. Her usually long and straight legs were so weak now that she was even a little unstable when standing. She subconsciously reached out her hand, trying to grab Lu Changsheng's sleeve.
The hand was bone-chilling and trembling in mid-air like a fallen leaf in the wind. It was obvious that this usually aloof master had been frightened by Jian Wuchen's murderous intention just now.
"Don't panic, Master."
Lu Changsheng caught a glimpse of her movements from the corner of his eye, and calmly turned slightly to the side, just in time to avoid her touch. He lowered his voice and warned with a weak breath that only the two of them could hear.
Then, he casually wiped the sweat that was still leaking out from his face, and forced a smile on his face that was a hundred times uglier than crying.
He took a deep breath and deliberately raised his voice so that his voice could be heard clearly in every corner of the hall, pretending to be upright and without any guilt:
"Master, there is no need to worry. The sect master is wise and powerful. He summoned the disciple alone. He just asked a few daily gossips. The disciple is upright and not afraid of the shadow. He is open and honest, so why should he be afraid?"
He shouted righteously, as if he was a loyal minister who wanted to die generously, but in his heart he had already pulled out all the eighteen generations of Jian Wuchen's ancestors to greet him.
But being under the eaves, with an invisible knife hanging on his neck, he had no choice but to accept the urging.
The night was so thick that it was like ink that could not be melted away with an inkstone. When I looked up, I couldn't even see any starlight. I couldn't really see my fingers.
The mountain wind is shrill, like invisible blunt knives, whistling and blowing on people's faces. The cold air poured into his chest roughly along the loose collar, making the bones in his bones ache from the cold.
Lu Changsheng grabbed the hem of his thin disciple uniform with both hands and stood in front of the cave where Jian Wuchen was.
His legs were swinging uncontrollably in the dark night - not because the mountain wind was too cold, but because of the pure fear of being shrouded in the shadow of death.
The surroundings were so quiet that it made people panic. There was no chirping of grass insects, and only the pounding sound of the heart in his chest was left in his ears. It was so heavy that even the eardrums hurt.
In the darkness without a trace of light, complex forbidden patterns were looming around the stone door of the cave. Even if the lines were just dormant, the spiritual pressure emitted would make people feel numb on the scalp.
With a formation of this level, let alone his mere Qi training period, even if the elders in the foundation building stage of the inner sect bumped into it, they would be crushed into a puddle of flesh in an instant.
Lu ChangshengHe swallowed hard, his throat was so dry that it hurt. The cold sweat that had finally dried up was rushing out of the pores at this moment, and it was sticky on the back. As the night wind blew, it was terribly uncomfortable.
Run.
A crazy voice screamed in his head. What a sect or a cultivator, hiding in a deep mountain forest and being a mortal, even if you eat chaffy vegetables every day and wait to die, it is better than having your head pinned to your waistband and giving it to this old monster to play as a ball.
But reason is like a bucket of ice water being poured down hard - it cannot escape. Once the Nascent Soul's powerful spiritual consciousness is spread out, it can cover the entire sect.
With his pitiful cultivation, he was afraid that he would be crushed to death by a big invisible hand like a bug before he even stepped out of the stone steps in front of the mountain gate. There is no way out but to bet your life on the gambling table.
Lu Changsheng closed his eyes, took a deep breath, and wiped the wet cold sweat from his hands on the hem of his clothes. He clenched his back teeth, raised his trembling hand, and knocked on the cold stone door.
Boom.
Boom.
Boom.
The three muffled sounds were particularly harsh in the dead night wind, and each blow was like a heavy hammer hitting his Tianling Cap.
"Come in."
A cold, dry voice, with no trace of the breath of life, came from the depths of the cave, like ice that had not melted for thousands of years.
Lu Changsheng's Adam's apple rolled, he pressed his hands on the heavy stone door and pushed hard.
Crunch——
A tooth-gripping sound broke the silence of the night. Immediately afterwards, an old musty smell that had not seen the light of day for many years, mixed with the sharp sword energy that could cut the skin, hit his face like a strong wind, making his lungs hurt, and he almost coughed.
